Item / 项目: Lease expiry or termination / 到期或解除
What to record / 核对事项: End date, contractual refund deadline and conditions / 终止日期及依据、押金返还期限和条件

Item / 项目: Return of the premises / 商铺交接
What to record / 核对事项: Move-out date, key handover date and recipient / 实际腾退日、交钥匙日及接收人

Item / 项目: Condition and meter readings / 设施与表计
What to record / 核对事项: Compare move-in and move-out records; attach paired photo references / 入场与退场时的设施状态、表数及对应照片编号
One row per transfer or cash receipt; name the recipient / 逐笔列明收款人及转账记录或收据
One row per actual refund; record payer and bank reference / 逐笔列明退款人及收款凭证
Compare the period claimed with rent receipts / 核对对方主张欠租期间与已付租金凭据

Item / 项目: Utilities and management charges / 水电费及物业费
What to record / 核对事项: Match bill dates and meter readings to handover / 对照账单期间、交接日及表数

Item / 项目: Reinstatement or repair / 恢复原状或维修费
What to record / 核对事项: State the affected item, handover condition, lease clause and quote or invoice / 列明部位、交接状况、合同条款及报价或票据

Item / 项目: Other proposed deductions / 其他主张扣款
What to record / 核对事项: Add one line for each separate charge / 每项单独一行

Item / 项目: Request for repayment / 催还记录
What to record / 核对事项: Record amount requested, date, reply and document reference / 记录请求金额、催还日期、答复及凭证编号
